note: Read by tests/run_ci.py. A suite fails CI when it prints a FAIL line not listed here, or exits non-zero without one (a crash). Entries match the start of a check's message exactly as the suite prints it after 'FAIL '. Keep this list short and specific: never add a pattern that could hide a new regression.

advisory._why: Timing measurements: they depend on the machine's speed and load (they fail when 15 browsers share 4 CPUs and pass alone). Reported in the summary, never block a deploy. The correctness checks in the same suites (landings, ranks 1..N, stale rows, scrolling stops at 0px, listeners, node counts) stay blocking.
